illustrationPrompts.style: atmospheric realistic painterly illustration; warm antique amber light, muted olive/brown mansion palette; landscape 4:3; no invented clues; reference illustrations only

images.title: 시신과 빈 서랍
images.brief: A dignified elderly Korean man in a dark suit sits motionless slumped forward at a grand study desk, viewed obliquely from the front, his face hidden by posture; one desk drawer is half-open and empty. Non-graphic crime scene, NO visible wounds or blood, no culprit or weapon.

images.title: 와인병과 잔
images.brief: A nearly full dark-green bottle of red wine beside a half-full clear wine glass on a mahogany study desk. Clearly visible pale undissolved powder sediment at the bottom of the GLASS only, no powder on the bottle. Close investigative still life, no medicine bottle.

images.title: 청동 부엉이상
images.brief: A heavy antique bronze owl statuette with a broad round base on a mansion bookshelf. A faint dusty circular footprint is slightly offset from its current position, and the underside edge has a faint wiped smudge. Several identical leather-bound books behind. No visible blood or killer.

images.title: 찢긴 일기장
images.brief: An open old leather diary with a page visibly torn out near its binding, ragged paper remnants, a few fragmented unreadable handwritten marks in one corner. On a mansion study desk. No readable confession, no suspect names or extra clues.

images.title: 회색 실오라기
images.brief: Macro investigative close-up of several short gray wool threads caught on an ornate dark burgundy carpet behind a carved wooden desk. The fibers are central and clearly visible. No whole shawl, no person, no indication of owner.

images.title: 집사의 첫 증언
images.brief: An elderly Korean butler in a restrained black formal suit and white shirt standing in a dim grand mansion corridor at a closed study door, cautiously recounting events, waist-up documentary illustration. No speech bubbles, no written testimony, no extra people or identifying clues.

images.title: 서로 다른 시계
images.brief: Three distinct antique mansion clocks arranged as an investigative triptych with no panel borders: corridor wall clock, ornate living-room mantel clock, and dining-room clock, their hands showing clearly different times. Brass and dark wood, no exact legible numbers required, no secret mechanisms revealed.

images.title: 차용증 원본
images.brief: A crumpled loan agreement tucked into the mouth of a decorative porcelain vase on a mansion corridor console, a dry brown stain at the corner of the paper. Some abstract document lines and signature marks, no legible invented amounts or names. Close evidence still life.

images.title: 빈 법률사무소 봉투
images.brief: An EMPTY cream legal document envelope with an unlettered scales-of-justice emblem, open flap and clearly empty interior, discarded in a small bedroom wastebasket. No document inside, no extra incriminating clues.

images.title: 수면제 통
images.brief: An open small amber prescription pill bottle inside an old leather physician's bag, white round tablets visible within bottle. Beside it a simple label with only 30 and a discreet evidence tally 28 as illustration design; no medical instructions or drug branding. No spilled extra pills, no syringe.

images.title: 외부 감사 일정
images.brief: A paper desk calendar and an audit appointment sheet on a lawyer's guestroom desk, one upcoming Monday appointment marked with THREE overlapping red pen circles. Fountain pen nearby. No readable invented dates, names or incriminating ledger.

images.title: 소장품 카탈로그
images.brief: An open fine-art collection catalog on an appraiser's desk with three dog-eared page corners and discreet pencil annotations in the margin, paintings reproduced as small thumbnails. No readable extra secrets, no forged-versus-real reveal, no people.

images.title: 취재수첩 첫 장
images.brief: The FIRST page of a journalist's small spiral notebook opened on a guestroom desk beside a black pen, sparse brief handwritten fragments including a clear 1995 and otherwise abstract strokes. No family photograph, no parentage reveal, no confession.

images.title: 회사의 내부 장부
images.brief: A worn company accounting ledger opened on a mansion table beside a lawyer's leather folio, multiple rows of financial entries, recurring transfers highlighted, a signature at bottom represented abstractly. No legible invented numbers, no person, no murder clues.

images.title: 새 유언장 초안
images.brief: An unsigned draft will on cream legal paper with a visibly BLANK beneficiary name field and blank signature line, several orderly clauses, held under a paperweight on a mansion side table. No readable invented legal details, no identified heir.

images.title: 차용증 사본
images.brief: A clean monochrome PHOTOCOPY of a loan agreement carried in a doctor's plain document folder, tidy printed lines and signature marks, slightly folded corners, no blood or stains, no porcelain vase. Contrast with crumpled stained original; no readable invented text.

images.title: 오래된 가족사진
images.brief: A faded 1990s family photograph lying on a wooden table: a younger Korean father in ordinary clothes, a Korean mother wearing a simple apron, and a one-year-old baby together, mild sepia fading and worn edges. Include a tiny secondary glimpse of photo reverse with 1995 only. No modern suspects shown, no confirmation caption.

images.title: 왼쪽 흰 면장갑
images.brief: ONE clean white cotton LEFT-HAND art-handling glove lying flat on dark green felt on a mansion side table. Five fingers with thumb arranged anatomically clearly as left glove. No right glove, no blood, no fire, no box or accusation.
